verdict.rationale: On GitHub, cubic lets developers trigger agent work from PR comments: `@cubic-dev-ai review this PR`, replies that ask questions, trigger reviews or request fixes, and a "Fix with cubic" button that pushes commits to the PR branch. That covers only one of the four surfaces in the story. Linear appears only as a source of requirements that cubic checks PRs against, not as a place to start tasks, and there is no evidence of GitLab or Slack support. Missing for 10: GitLab triggering, Linear-initiated tasks, Slack-initiated tasks, independent corroboration of GitHub triggers.
